newsitem.title: USA: Commander Aircraft sees revenue improvement.
newsitem.headline: Commander Aircraft sees revenue improvement.

text.p: Commander Aircraft Co said Wednesday it expects revenues and operating margins to continue improving.

"Commander's second quarter results improved from the previous year and prior quarter but are still affected by the continued depressed market for new single engine, high performance aircraft," said Wirt Walker, Commander's chairman, in an earnings statement. "However, the company currently has a backlog in excess of $2.0 million and is expecting further improvement in revenues and operating margins."
Commander makes, markets and provides support services for its line of single-engine, high-performance aircraft.
Earlier Wednesday, it reported a loss of $0.08 per share in the second quarter compared to a loss of 0.13 per share during the same 1996 fiscal quarter.
